about: Sentry issues owned by another program. stability-health.py lists them in its other-owner row and does not count them against p10 done check 21. An entry matches by github_issue (a GitHub link on the Sentry issue), sentry_issues (short ids) or pattern (a regex over the title and culprit). Remove an entry when its owner lands the fix.
